slides.description: How it works
OMA is composed of the following: UI STT (speech-to-text), TTS (text-to-speech) Hyprland's window recognition Long-term memory OMA Skill
OMA provides a GUI and voice interface to AI agents
Diagram: OMA provides a GUI and voice interface layer for AI agents.
About listening and speaking
Default
Diagram: Listen with GPT Live, Speak with GPT Live, Think with Codex.
Each part can use a different model
Diagram: Listen with Whisper, Speak with Qwen3, Think with Claude.
I am still looking for local models that run on most PCs and work well in Japanese and other languages. We may be close.
UI
Annotated OMA user interface.
Long-term memory OMA has its own long-term memory, separate from the AI agent's memory
OMA Skill Most OMA-specific behavior is defined in the OMA Skill
What's next Find speech recognition and synthesis models that work well in most languages, and make them the default. Make small tasks possible without looking at the screen or using the keyboard.
Try it and tell me what you think If you are interested, please try OMA and share your feedback. If your first language is not Japanese, I would especially like to know how the voice sounds to you.
Thank you for listening! GitHub: https://github.com/komagata/oma Blog post: https://docs.komagata.org/6487
